# Key-by-key table (generated by make_vil.py)

Matrix (row,col) as Vial shows it when you hover a key: left half rows 4-6, right half rows 0-2, encoder click (3,0). Columns run pinky to inner for both halves. · = KC_NO (dead key), ▽ = transparent.

## Layer 0: BASE

| Half | Row | pinky | ring | middle | index | inner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| left | top | KC_Q | KC_W | KC_E | KC_R | KC_T |
| left | home | KC_A | KC_S | KC_D | KC_F | KC_G |
| left | bottom | LGUI_T(KC_Z) | LALT_T(KC_X) | LCTL_T(KC_C) | LSFT_T(KC_V) | KC_B |
| right | top | KC_P | KC_O | KC_I | KC_U | KC_Y |
| right | home | KC_SCOLON | KC_L | KC_K | KC_J | KC_H |
| right | bottom | KC_SLASH | RALT_T(KC_DOT) | RCTL_T(KC_COMMA) | RSFT_T(KC_M) | KC_N |

Left thumbs (outer, middle, inner): KC_ESCAPE, KC_SPACE, LT2(KC_TAB). Right thumbs (inner, middle, outer): MO(1), KC_BSPACE, KC_ENTER.
Encoder: turn CCW = KC_VOLD, CW = KC_VOLU, click = KC_MUTE.
